correctness.rationale: For finite \(p\), applying the scalar two-by-two operator norm coordinatewise and summing p-th powers bounds both Banach-space outputs; their minimum is therefore at most the scalar norm. Conversely, compactness gives a scalar maximizing pair \((a,b)\); embedding \(x=(a,b)\) and \(y=(b,-a)\) in two coordinates makes the two output norms equal to the scalar extremal norm. The infinity endpoint follows from the row-sum norm. Symmetry of the matrix plus standard operator duality gives the Holder-conjugate identity, and the p=1,2,infinity values follow immediately.

It does not determine the exact value on the full ell-p family.
